component.name: Sele
component.summary: Desktop workspace for AI coding agents

description.p: Sele is an unofficial fork of T3 Code for working with AI coding agents across local and remote projects. It brings conversations, diffs, file browsing, and terminal sessions together in one focused workspace.
The Flatpak uses host command execution and filesystem access so that coding agent CLIs, Git, shells, and developer tools installed on your computer remain available to Sele and its agents.
Restored host execution via flatpak-spawn for coding agents, Git, and terminals in Flatpak builds, added SSH agent and keyring access, and disabled the broken host CLI shim inside Flatpak.
Project scripts now wait for the terminal shell to be ready before running, so commands no longer get lost in new terminals.
Rebuilt Sele on top of the open-source T3 Code architecture with multi-agent orchestration, worktree diffs, terminal tabs, remote access, and cross-platform auto-updates.
